meta.title: knowbase
meta.description: My data: upload, describe and show it to my applications.

public.title: All my data, in one place
public.description: Upload your own material, see what was collected or bought for you, and decide which applications may show it. Data seen in knowbench, knowlab and knowmart is managed here.

errors.notFoundDescription: The requested page does not exist or is no longer available.

auth.logoutFailed: Sign out failed. Please try again.
auth.loginSubtitle: You will be redirected to the identity provider to sign in.
auth.loginCasdoorHint: If you only registered on Casdoor, still click Login here to open this app.
auth.continueToDashboard: Already signed in to this site? Go to dashboard
auth.errorAuthFailed: Sign-in could not finish (token exchange failed). Check backend logs for Casdoor/Redis errors and ensure the redirect URI in Casdoor matches CASDOOR_REDIRECT_URI exactly.
auth.errorNoCode: No authorization code was returned. Click Login again from this page.
auth.errorOAuthGeneric: Authorization was denied or cancelled. Please try again.
auth.signupSuccessHint: Sign-up succeeded. Click Login below to enter this app.

interaction.loadFailed: The live workspace could not be loaded
interaction.loadFailedHint: The paired backend failed or returned an incompatible contract.
interaction.actionFailed: The action was not accepted. Reconcile and try again.

library.title: My data
library.lead: Everything in my name: uploaded, collected for me, purchased, and outputs. View it, fix descriptions and decide where it is shown.

upload.title: Upload
upload.lead: PDF, Excel, CSV, text and Markdown; up to 50 MB each and 1 GB per account.

consents.title: Platform consents
consents.lead: Consents I gave to platform processes and the scope consents of my knowfeed subscriptions. Each can be withdrawn and stops at once.

form.subject: Subject (security code)
form.researchHint: Research dimensions: check what was recognised from the first page; they count only once confirmed.

upload.directTitle: {app} needs this material and cannot collect it; upload it here
upload.directHint: The description is prefilled with what {app} needs. After uploading it is also shown to {app} and you return to where you were.
upload.limits: PDF, Excel (xlsx, xls), CSV, text or Markdown, at most {size} each.
upload.tooLarge: The file is larger than {size} and cannot be uploaded.
upload.recognizing: Recognising the description from the file name and first page…
upload.recognized: {count} fields recognised and marked “to confirm”; please check them.
upload.recognizedNothing: Nothing was recognised; please fill it in.
upload.duplicate: A material with the same name and description already exists. This file is:
upload.describeHint: The description decides whether applications can find this material when they look for data.
upload.confirm: The description is right; I confirm it
upload.confirmHint: You may upload without confirming; it stays “to confirm” and is not used for resolution until you confirm it in the details.
upload.processHint: knowfeed produces the body text, page text and tables (matching types use domain plug-ins, such as annual-report tables); scanned files and the search index are done by knowbase through RAGFlow. knowfeed processes only this file and keeps no copy. Ticking this adopts processing.
upload.defaultShown: After upload it is shown to knowbench and knowlab per your account setting.
upload.defaultNotShown: After upload it is not shown to any application; use the display buttons in the details.
upload.willReturn: You will return to the previous page
upload.quotaHint: Delete material you no longer need to free space.

license.title: License
license.via_expert: Others may use it through experts
license.attest: I have the right to make this material “{license}”.
license.logged: Raising needs the “I have the right” tick; every change is logged.
license.fixed: Collected, purchased and converted material has a system-set license.

errors.unknown: That did not work; please retry ({code}).
errors.type_not_allowed: Only PDF, Excel (xlsx, xls), CSV, text and Markdown are accepted.
errors.content_mismatch: The file content does not match its extension.
errors.too_large: The file is larger than 50 MB.
errors.quota_exceeded: Your 1 GB of space is used up.
errors.attest_required: Tick “I have the right” to choose a higher license.
errors.name_invalid: The file name is not allowed.
errors.license_fixed: This license is set by the system.
errors.license_above_upstream: The upstream data does not allow this license.
errors.item_not_found: No such material, or it is not yours.
errors.expert_not_found: Not an expert in your name.
errors.not_owner: Only the owner can hand material to knowmart.
errors.output_immutable: Outputs are not revised; convert to data first.
errors.version_conflict: Another version was just added; refresh and retry.
errors.not_upload: Only uploaded material is processed on consent.
errors.doc_type_invalid: The type is not in the vocabulary.
errors.period_invalid: A period needs both ends, start not after end.
errors.topics_invalid: A topic is not in the vocabulary.
errors.contract_invalid: The server answer did not match; please refresh.
errors.request_failed: Could not reach the server; please retry.

detail.oldVocabulary: Uses an old vocabulary; please confirm again
detail.unconfirmedHint: Recognised or migrated descriptions are used for resolution only after you confirm.
detail.versionsHint: A content version replaces the content; readings are the body text, page text, tables and search index of one version.
detail.processNew: Hand this version to knowfeed for processing

display.title: Where it is shown
display.knowbenchHint: Used for both commissions and chats; in a chat the model may read any item in the column when needed.
display.marketHint: knowmart checks the license again when listing.
display.bindHint: Experts run on the computer of whoever calls them and the bound text enters their context; we only guarantee there is no way to browse or download it. Unbinding affects only the next version; delivered versions keep it.
display.noExperts: No experts in your name yet (they appear once knowlab creates a version).

impact.title: What is affected:
impact.market: Handed to knowmart: it will be withdrawn
impact.marketLowering: Handed to knowmart: its listing will be taken down
impact.grants: {count} running grants pin it (until they end)

convert.title: Convert output to data
convert.hint: Creates a new material with its provenance (expert and version, task, inputs). If upstream data is restricted, the license cannot exceed it.

delete.explain: Deleting only removes it from your columns: buyers, pinned tests and expert versions can still read it.

shelf.defaultTitle: Show new data to all my applications by default
shelf.defaultExplain: When on, new uploaded and collected data is shown to knowbench and knowlab automatically; purchased and converted data needs a click. It takes effect only after you choose.
shelf.unconfirmedHint: {count} materials have unconfirmed descriptions; they are used only after you confirm.
shelf.bulkDeleteConfirm: Delete these {count}? Buyers, pinned tests and expert versions can still read them.
shelf.title: Materials
shelf.empty: No material yet. Try uploading one.
shelf.name: Name
shelf.notFound: This material is not in your name or was deleted.

consents.platformHint: Left during knowlab platform incubation, tests, delivery reviews and reruns: which process, which items, until when, and how often platform staff read them.
consents.withdrawConfirm: After withdrawing, this process can no longer read the material. Continue?
consents.subscriptionHint: Left when creating subscriptions in knowfeed. Withdrawing stops new requests.
consents.unsubscribeConfirm: After withdrawing, knowfeed stops creating requests for this subscription. Continue?

settings.defaultDisplay: Show new data to all my applications by default
settings.defaultDisplayHint: Applies only to uploaded and collected data; purchased and converted data needs a click.
settings.notSeen: Not chosen yet: nothing is shown automatically. Click the switch to decide.
